sections.content: You know *me gustaría* from Unit 8 as a set phrase. It is one form of the conditional (*condicional simple*), which expresses what would happen. Formation is simple: take the entire infinitive and add the conditional endings. Unlike the present or preterite, -AR, -ER, and -IR verbs use the EXACT same endings!

items.spanish: Me gustaría viajar a España este verano.
items.english: I would like to travel to Spain this summer.

items.spanish: Con más tiempo, viviríamos cerca de la playa.
items.english: With more time, we would live near the beach.
Would you eat paella every day?

sections.content: Notice that EVERY single conditional ending has an accent mark on the letter 'í' (-ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -íais, -ían).
